text:
maya: Quick pass on chart layout — legend density + axis labelling is messy in compact dashboard rows.
jonah: On small widths legend wraps and pushes charts. Suggest collapsed inline legend with count badge.
lia: Collapse with a chevron sounds good. Make label short: 'Series' and use a visually-hidden full label for screen readers.
pat: Also band fills are opaque and hide gridlines. Propose 35% fill and thin stroke for lines.
samir: ARIA: band should be announced as 'typical range (10th90th percentile) for <series name>'. Avoid 'band' alone.
a11y-bot: Checklist: "legend toggle aria-expanded; focusable; aria-label includes series count; band aria-description includes percentiles; contrast >=4.5:1 on focus".
zara: Outlier handling: rather than clipping scale, dim + mark outliers and include a tooltip 'excluded from auto-scale: value' with reason.
jonah: UI: show small badge 'Outlier dimming on' near legend when enabled; clicking opens config with a slider and preview sparkline.
lia: For tiny charts hide minor ticks and abbreviate units (K, M) with full values exposed to screen readers.
pat: Dev note: renderer prefers a uniform alpha for band fills and a mask texture for per-point dimming. Avoid per-DOM operations.
maya: Action items: Lia draft microcopy; Samir prepare ARIA strings and a11y test steps; Pat sketch shader approach; Jonah spec collapse interactions & keyboard flow. I'll update Figma.
jonah: I'll demo a tiny PR in staging.
maya: Thanks, aiming to include these in next sprint. :thumbsup:
